changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetError') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetError]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionAssetError] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
